description: Log {{...}} template expressions (Jinja2, Twig, Mustache, Handlebars). Replaces three byte-identical rules whose stacked scores (21) block any body containing template syntax on their own; one rule at score 4 stays below the default threshold.

Log ${...} interpolation (FreeMarker, Velocity, Thymeleaf, Mako -- four byte-identical rules deduplicated). Score 4: shell/JS/CI snippets in bodies legitimately contain ${...}, so this must not block alone; JNDI abuse is separately blocked by log4shell-jndi.
Log <%...%> tags (EJS, ERB, JSP, ASP). The separate <%=...%> expression rule was a strict subset and always double-fired.
